messages.author: 613ee25ed19799ae
messages.subject: Error in readDcf(file.path(project, "DESCRIPTION"))[, "Package"]
parts:
I'm trying to publish an app to the shinyapps.io with display mode turned on, but I get the following error:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 76840...Error in readDcf(file.path(project, "DESCRIPTION"))[, "Package"] : 
  subscript out of bounds
Calls: <Anonymous> ... suppressMessages -> withCallingHandlers -> <Anonymous> -> unname
Execution halted

My DESCRIPTION file is simply this:

 Title: R Instance Calculator 
 Author: RStudio, Inc. 
 DisplayMode: Showcase


If I remove the last line "DisplayMode: Showcase" then I can publish without errors. 

My packages are to date from github (rsconnect, shinyapps, packrat).

Nathan

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error in readDcf(file.path(project, "DESCRIPTION"))[, "Package"]
parts:
Basically, packrat decides that your project is an R package when a DESCRIPTION file exists and one of these hold:

    (1) It has no 'Type:' field, or
    (2) It has the 'Type: Package' field.

Note that we accept (1) There were some packrat bugs reported as apparently it's legal to declare an R package without the 'Type:' field in the DESCRIPTION.

Perhaps this could be a bit stricter (we could check both for a 'Type:' field and a 'Package:' field before deciding that we're truly within an R package).

Just reading through the source for packrat and found this:

Try adding "Type: Shiny" to your DESCRIPTION file.
